classification: Genuine official Excalidraw app UI-created mixed scene, exported via official Save to file. UI was machine driven using Playwright native mouse, keyboard, tool/menu clicks and filechooser.setFiles.

sourceApplication.title: Excalidraw Whiteboard
sourceApplication.deployedReleaseVersion: Not asserted; no release/version exposed in observed UI. Exact loaded main bundle is identified below.

original.unchanged: Saved directly from the real Playwright download event. Never parsed and reserialized into the original file.

asset.classification: Existing synthetic local test fixture; not third-party or user content. 1x1 RGBA steel-blue pixel [70,130,180,255], enlarged by native official-app resize to a visible 159x159 image.

isolation.profile: Fresh nonpersistent Playwright context; no user browser/profile/storage state
isolation.sceneCreation: All elements created through visible toolbar/menu/native keyboard/mouse operations. No fabricated element JSON import, app API or internal constructor calls.
isolation.fallbackReason: Headless Chrome exposed native File System Access functions but UI produced neither Playwright filechooser nor download. First complete attempt is retained under attempt-native-fs; one ineffective --disable-features=FileSystemAccessAPI capability check is under attempt-ineffective-base-flag. Final browser capability flag removes only native OS picker API so official app uses its own file-input/download fallback. No app implementation replacement.
isolation.publishing: No account/login/live collaboration/public sharing or publishing action

manualVisualReview: The assistant viewed the full screenshot: bound labeled rectangle, arrow between rectangle and ellipse, diamond, free text, independent line, framed freehand and enlarged steel-blue image are visibly distinct. Screenshot coordinates correspond to export x/y/width/height.
validation: verify-provenance.py asserts required types, both arrow bindings and reciprocal references, bound-label references, frame membership, visible image dimensions and exact input/embedded bytes. No browser reopen performed.
